comparison.objective: Regulate a pendulum to a one-second period by repeated observation and bob repositioning; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper for safe repeatable stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Pendulum timing and sliding/repositioning a bob versus hex-key setscrew engagement, collar rotation, counterholding, relocking, and guarded impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: One-second free-swing period versus two ≥0.85 J stops within velocity/stroke limits, without bottoming, rebound, overload, or setting drift. Pendulum record lacks a numeric tolerance and detailed damage rubric.
comparison.reason: Both use observation-driven adjustment, but they test different dynamics and manipulation: changing pendulum geometry versus unlocking, tuning, and mechanically retaining an impact damper.
